key.name: panel-left
key.summary: Items in the left zone of the panel
key.description: Item ids, in order from left to right.

key.name: panel-center
key.summary: Items in the center zone of the panel
key.description: Item ids, in order from left to right.

key.name: panel-right
key.summary: Items in the right zone of the panel
key.description: Item ids, in order from left to right.

key.name: quick-settings
key.summary: Switches in the quick settings menu

key.name: banner-ignore-timeout
key.description: How long a notification banner without its own timeout stays on screen while the user is active and leaves it alone, before it moves to the notification list. 0 keeps it until the user acts on it. Values from 1 to 4 count as 5.

key.name: critical-banner-ignore-timeout
key.description: The same as banner-ignore-timeout, for critical (urgent) notifications. 0 keeps them until the user acts on them.

key.name: app-grid-recent
key.summary: Show recently used apps in the app grid
key.description: Whether the first page of the app grid starts with a row of the apps launched last. The row never shows while org.gnome.desktop.privacy remember-app-usage is off.
